key_entities: Streaming validation (use when Discovery is sharded)
propositions: Discovery skill has only eight concerns and lacks coverage for unwired or partially wired functionality, the highest-yield finding class from the 2026-08-05/06 rebar-janitor run
Two discovery concerns (comment quality, test-suite health) are too large for single subagent review and lack sharding or streaming-validation guidance
Verification phase has no guidance for validating a sharded discovery stream
Three Markdown files in the packaged example skill must be updated to document concerns 9-11, streaming validation principles, and sharding guidance, with content already authored and byte-verified
